## Change

Describe what capability, check, workflow or documentation behavior changed.

## Safety impact

- [ ] Read-only change
- [ ] Changes a destructive/gated path
- [ ] Adds or changes secret handling
- [ ] Adds or changes production behavior

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] Config example updated if needed
- [ ] Skill contract updated
- [ ] Documentation updated

## Regression traceability

If this change fixes an upgrade incident, include the stable check/test ID that prevents recurrence.
